signal: VertexOne launched VXconnect, its modern customer engagement engine, and acquired Accelerated Innovations (MyMeter) to expand utility CX

email.body1:
Andrew, saw VertexOne launched VXconnect and acquired Accelerated Innovations to expand utility customer engagement.

A new engagement engine plus an acquisition usually means more utility accounts in play than the team can cover before reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for your region off VertexOne's hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Andrew, quick follow-up for your region.

With VXconnect and MyMeter widening the story, the pipeline target across mid-market utilities usually climbs faster than headcount can. Most teams don't know exactly how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your region needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Andrew, last bit of proof for VertexOne.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your region's reply rate likely compares to other utility-software GTM teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Andrew, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling regional pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority while you integrate MyMeter, no problem at all. An acquisition is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a utility-software motion? I'll tailor it to your region either way.
